The '''Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actress – Motion Picture''' is a [[Golden Globe Awards|Golden Globe Award]] that was first awarded by the [[Hollywood Foreign Press Association]] in 1944 for a performance in a motion picture released in the previous year.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.goldenglobes.com/history-golden-globes|title=History of the Golden Globes|access-date=2021-03-14|archive-date=2018-07-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180720235613/https://www.goldenglobes.com/history-golden-globes|url-status=live}}</ref>

The formal title has varied since its inception; since 2005, the award has officially been called "Best Performance by an Actress in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture".
